D.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the scholarship deadline
has closed and is in the process of reviewing all applicants; provided updates on the C. Robert Lee
renovations; and that the summer program guide will be distributed to residents in March

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that a Neighborhood Safety Meeting will be held on
March 4, 2026 at Fedde Middle School.

Neema Ghanbari, Public Works Manager, announced that the city secured 100% cost­saving coverage
for the removal and replacement of six water heaters for several city buildings; and provided an update
on the Los Angeles County Sewer Relining Project.

Elise McCaleb, Community Development Director, announced new regulations on blackjack that would
impact the Gardens Casino.

Sergeant Bitolas spoke and introduced two new deputies: Deputy Reyes and Deputy Gonzalez.

  Code Section 54956.9: (one potential case)

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, read the Closed Session items into the record.

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session at 6:44 PM.

  The City Council reconvened from Closed Session at 7:25 PM.

  Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, conducted a roll call and announced a quorum.

  Norma Tabares, City Attorney, stated no reportable action from Closed Session.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting in memory of Robert Prida at 7:25 PM to the next Regular City
Council meeting to be held on Wednesday, March 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
